title: color_rgba element type guard is dead code (checks outer `ok`, not `okc`) — malformed element silently becomes 0 instead of fail-fast
detail: ODN-5/Story-3.1 AC: catalogs are "fail-fast validated at load [ODN-5]" with "NO silent defaults on malformed JSON". `!ok` tests the outer root-object assert (always true here); `okc` is never checked. Dynamically verified: `"color_rgba":[90,"oops",112,255]` loads as [90,0,112,255] with no error; a float 98.5 element is likewise accepted.
recommended_fix: Change `if !ok ||` to `if !okc ||` so a non-integer color_rgba element hits the existing fail-fast return.

title: Set-piece tick fields u64-wrap negatives with no fail-fast — start_tick -5 loads as 18446744073709551611
detail: ODN-5: "out-of-range values ... abort startup with a named error". Negative ticks pass u64() unvalidated (the range check covers only multiplier/duration==0). Dynamically verified: `"start_tick":-5` loads as 18446744073709551611 (set-piece silently never fires); a negative duration_ticks wraps to a ~permanently-active window.
recommended_fix: Read ticks into i32 locals first and reject < 0 (e.g. `if sp_start < 0 || sp_dur < 0 || sp_lead < 0 { return ... }`) before the u64 casts.

title: weighted_pick doc comment contradicts the code on zero/negative weights
detail: The comment claims a zero/negative weight "still counts toward the total"; the code excludes non-positive weights from `total` (and demand_test.odin states the correct behavior: "zero-weight is never picked (but counts toward nothing)"). Misleading doc on the §3.3 rule's load-bearing proc; code is correct.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to "a zero/negative weight is never picked and is excluded from the total".
